prior.interpretation: Descriptive A-line repeated-person diagnostic, not a causal effect or PIT B forecast. Previous/current rolling 12-month windows overlap 11 months. Prior-only benchmarks condition on returning valid respondents and current evaluation weights.

diary.interpretation: Recorded days with positive published costs, conditional on support; not transaction counts, attention, or annual frequency. Weekly zeros are censored exposure observations, not stable nonconsumer labels. Current corrected 2020Q4 file is A-only unless a historical B version is independently established.
